> 第7章 龙啸响全宗（第1页）
自打张云穿越来，这峰里就只有他一人。
峰内大多建筑都积上了厚厚的灰，显得有些破旧，只有一座药田所在的院子还算干净。
这院子深处有一座小型洞府，是张云平日的住处。
洞府内，张云微笑看着身前徐鸣：“徒儿，对你现在的身体状况感觉如何？”
徐鸣闻言，有些兴奋握了握双拳：“师傅，我感觉我好像又拥有完整灵根了，现在浑身都充满力量！”
毕竟他的龙灵根明明已经给剥夺了，如今就剩下残灵根。但在被张云用金匕首扎了一下后，他感觉他的力量，一下恢复到了龙灵根没被夺之前，甚至犹有过之。
张云笑道：“这是因为你的二灵根被激活了！”
“在你身上，除了被剥夺的龙灵根外，还存在着第二道灵根！”
张云侃侃而谈：“此灵根乃变异赤金龙灵根，属于变异类的龙灵根。为师先前之所以用金匕首扎你，就是因为只有用金质物触入你血肉，才能将此灵根激活！”
“不过这方法只能短暂激活你的灵根，最多维持一个月便会消失！”
听到这话，徐鸣脸色变了，“师傅，那一个月后我岂不是……”
张云摆手，笑道：“为师会想办法帮你维持住的。”
张云顿了顿，道：“想要彻底将你这道灵根激活，需要一件很难得之物。想获取此物，需要很强大的实力。以你现在的能力，还远远不够！”
闻言，徐鸣咬牙道：“师傅，我想变强！”
“谁都想变强，但这需要你的努力！”
“师傅，我向你保证。我会尽全力修炼，决不懈怠！！”
“好！这才是身为我张云之徒该有的精神！”
看着一脸认真的徐鸣，张云道：“为师现在传你一门功法，你仔细听好！”

“此功法名为金龙九变。一变金龙啸；二变金龙瞳；三变金龙爪……”
听着张云的讲述，徐鸣脸上逐渐露出惊讶之色。
虽然他没见过那些高等级功法，但也能听出这门功法的不凡。
“师傅，这金龙九变是入阶功法吗？”
认真听张云讲完后，徐鸣忍不住询问。
张云一脸高深莫测的模样，笑着反问：“你觉得呢？”
这至少要达到灵阶级别以上的功法，才能被称为入阶。
此等功法，已经能作为一方修仙宗门开宗立派的镇宗之法了。甚至一些修仙宗门，都没有这等功法。
眼下张云随便传授给他一门功法，竟然就是这等级的？

> Chapter 7 The roar of the dragon echoes throughout the sect (page 1)
Ever since Zhang Yun traveled through time, he was the only one on this peak.
Most of the buildings in the peak were covered with thick dust and looked a little dilapidated. Only the courtyard where a medicinal field was located was still clean.
There is a small cave house deep in the courtyard, which is Zhang Yun's daily residence.
In the cave, Zhang Yun looked at Xu Ming in front of him with a smile: "Disciple, how do you feel about your current physical condition?"
Hearing this, Xu Ming clenched his fists with some excitement: "Master, I feel like I have a complete spiritual root again, and now my whole body is full of strength!"
After all, his dragon spirit root has obviously been taken away, and now only the residual spirit root is left. But after being stabbed by Zhang Yun with a golden dagger, he felt that his strength suddenly returned to what it was before the Dragon Spirit Root was taken away, or even worse.
Zhang Yun smiled and said: "This is because your second spiritual root has been activated!"
"In addition to the deprived dragon spiritual root, there is also a second spiritual root in you!"
Zhang Yun talked eloquently: "This spiritual root is a mutated red gold dragon spiritual root, which belongs to the mutated type of dragon spiritual root. The reason why I stabbed you with a gold dagger before is because this spiritual root can only be activated by touching your flesh and blood with a gold object!"
"However, this method can only activate your spiritual roots for a short period of time. It can last for up to a month before disappearing!"
Hearing this, Xu Ming's expression changed, "Master, in one month, wouldn't I be..."
Zhang Yun waved his hand and said with a smile: "As a teacher, I will find a way to help you maintain it."
Zhang Yun paused and said: "To completely activate your spiritual root, you need a very rare thing. To obtain this thing, you need very strong strength. With your current ability, it is far from enough!"
Hearing this, Xu Ming gritted his teeth and said, "Master, I want to become stronger!"
"Everyone wants to become stronger, but it requires your efforts!"
"Master, I promise you. I will try my best to practice and never slack off!!"
"Okay! This is the spirit I, Zhang Yun, should have as a disciple!"
Looking at Xu Ming who looked serious, Zhang Yun said: "Master is now teaching you a skill, please listen carefully!"
"This technique is called the Nine Transformations of the Golden Dragon. The first transformation is the golden dragon roar; the second transformation is the golden dragon pupils; the third transformation is the golden dragon claws..."
Listening to Zhang Yun's story, Xu Ming gradually showed a look of surprise on his face.
Although he has never seen those high-level techniques, he can still hear how extraordinary this technique is.
"Master, is this Nine Transformations of the Golden Dragon an advanced technique?"
After listening carefully to Zhang Yun's words, Xu Ming couldn't help but ask.
Zhang Yun looked incomprehensible and asked with a smile: "What do you think?"
This technique must reach at least the spiritual level or above before it can be called an advanced level.
These skills can already be used as a method to suppress the sect of a sect that cultivates immortality. Even some immortal cultivating sects do not have such techniques.
